# A fixture soft check whose review has lapsed

## Rule
A hypothetical reader scene, a "not X but Y" reversal and a question standing
where the ending should be are worth noticing. None of them is a reason to
block, edit or replan anything.

## Criterion
Code finds the openers and the reversal shapes it can match as strings. The
execution call answers what the strings miss. No threshold decides anything
(I-12).

## Enforces
Nothing. It is a fixture check for the Knowledge Maintenance job: §5 keeps a
check's rule status past its `review_by` and flags it, so an expired candidate
check is still a candidate check.

## Route
| Finding | Route | Cause | Counter | On exhaustion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| a hypothetical reader scene | hint | — | — | — |
| a "not X but Y" reversal | hint | — | — | — |
